In Lightning > Funding, check Your balance in channels in light and dark mode. The purple amount is your side of the channels and counts toward the total. On-chain funds and estimated Lightning sending capacity have their own rows. While reconnecting, the last reported channel balance stays visible. Check that hiding amounts also hides each row.

Using disposable test data, check that a new-channel review accepts 100,000,000 sats (1 XBT) and blocks 100,000,001 sats. An existing channel can review a larger resize if its funds, peers and fee rules allow. Dismiss the review before confirming.

On Pay Invoice, the activity indicator is centered in the status panel. A failed outgoing Lightning receipt shows the failure reason when the node has recorded one.
